text: ok, well. so the doors show up. i can open them. i cant walk through the open door. i can walk through the open doorway that has no door though
resolution: Open doors now admit the body in the compiled game. Root cause was a host-physics law, not the door machine: collideSolidRects (framework/game/physics.zig) side-pushes ANY rect too tall to step onto even when non-solid — that is what makes walkable platforms push you off their sides — so the first cut's toggle, which only flipped the blocksPlayer float, left a 2.2m phantom rect standing in the open doorway. The toggle now PARKS the door rect 1e9m out of the world while open and restores the exact closed bounds on close; startOpen doors boot parked the same way; doorHalfExtents is the single bounds source for build+toggle. Loader rebuilt, rjit game shot GREEN (door layer: 2 live doors, no-JS proof intact); the walk-through itself is yours to confirm in play.
